sources.code: globalThis.s02ReopenContext=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:1280,height:900}});globalThis.s02ReopenPage=await s02ReopenContext.newPage();globalThis.s02ReopenWire=[];globalThis.s02ReopenRecord=false;await s02ReopenContext.route('**/*',async route=>{const u=new URL(route.request().url());if(u.origin!=='http://127.0.0.1:7070'||!u.pathname.startsWith('/api/'))return route.continue();const upstream='http://127.0.0.1:8110'+(u.pathname.startsWith('/api/f/')?u.pathname.slice(6):u.pathname.replace(/^\/api/,'/de2api'))+u.search;try{const response=await route.fetch({url:upstream,maxRedirects:0});if(response.status()>=300&&response.status()<400)throw Error('REDIRECT_REFUSED');if(s02ReopenRecord&&/\/(chartData\/getData|dataVisualization\/(findById|updateCanvas))$/.test(u.pathname))s02ReopenWire.push({at:new Date().toISOString(),path:u.pathname,upstream,method:route.request().method(),status:response.status(),request:route.request().postData(),body:await response.text()});await route.fulfill({response});}catch{if(s02ReopenRecord)s02ReopenWire.push({at:new Date().toISOString(),path:u.pathname,status:'UPSTREAM_FAILED_NO_FALLBACK'});await route.abort('failed');}});
